Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.grammar

Class Command

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.grammar.Command
public final class Command extends Object
One step a Blueprint asks a grammar to compile, such as creating the table or adding a unique index.

A command is a name and a set of attributes, so later versions can add commands and attributes without changing this type. Instances are immutable.

      public Command(String name, Map<String,?> attributes)
      Creates a command.
      Parameters:
      name - the command name, never null
      attributes - the attributes, never null; copied, and each List value is copied into an unmodifiable list
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument, a key or a value is null
